value.rationale: The Hesse modular rational elliptic surface is a canonical extremal example with 4 I3 fibers and finite 3-torsion Mordell–Weil group. Its full big-cone Zariski-chamber support polynomial is a natural invariant, and the local incidence characterization illuminates all possible support types. This is not a reparameterization of the general algorithm or a tiny arbitrary slice: it determines the complete stratification of a classical surface.
